title: KSrelief provides drinking water to 2,000 displaced people in Yemen
description: JEDDAH: Saudi aid agency KSrelief recently supplied drinking water to more than 2,000 displaced people from 300 families at Al-Firdaws Camp 2 in Yemen’s Aden governorate. The water was delivered to six distribution points at the camp in Al-Buraiqah district as part of an emergency project, according to the Saudi Press Agency. The operation was part of Saudi Arabia’s wider humanitarian efforts to improve living conditions for people across Yemen.

title: Netanyahu rebuked for plan to use crypto to bypass economic sanctions
description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces criticism for suggesting the use of cryptocurrency to shield Israel’s economy from sanctions. The proposal comes ahead of Israel’s elections and is being criticized by economists and the central bank.

title: Jordan unites in grief as eight victims of church terror attack laid to rest
description: CAIRO: Jordanians on Sunday mourned eight people killed in a terrorist attack on a church in Hammoud village in Karak province, as thousands attended their funerals amid an outpouring of grief. Officials and members of the public gathered near the targeted church, expressing national unity in the face of terrorism, as shown on Jordanian state television. The recognition celebrates female artists from the Middle East and North Africa whose work challenges conventions and offers distinctive perspectives. title: Far-right leader Le Pen says visible policing keeps protests smooth
description: Meanwhile, France’s far-right National Rally is holding the second day of its party congress in Orléans, south of Paris. title: Suspect in racist Paris shooting transferred to psychiatric unit, had drugs in his system
description: A shooter suspected of killing one person and wounding five others on Friday in the town of Trappes, near Paris, has had his police custody suspended for a 48-hour psychiatric observation, anti-terror prosecutors said Sunday. The 39-year-old man is believed to have had racist motivations behind the gun attack as most of the victims had foreign origins.
